description: Channel-aware STT cleanup eval set. Each case is one raw speech transcript for a target app, the channel it should map to, an illustrative expected output, and machine-checkable assertions. `assert.resolvesTo` and `assert.promptIncludes` are checked statically (no LLM); `assert.output` is checked live against POST /cleanup when PYAI_PROXY_URL is set. See run.mjs and README.md.

It was really nice to meet you the other day. When could we meet next — perhaps sometime next week?

Thanks,

Hi,

Here's a quick update on the mobile app launch. We completed the payment integration yesterday, and QA has been testing since this morning.

Two issues remain open:
- The checkout screen crashes when the coupon field is empty.
- The order history page loads slowly.

Marketing would like to go live on the 15th; however, I'd recommend we hold until both issues are resolved. We also need to update the App Store screenshots before submission, and I still need to write the release notes.

Best,
